acceptanceCriteria: A01: OBS-01 — 同 tree/空 commit 保持 source identity，真实源码变化使相关证据失效；Contract、Runtime digest、preflight、verification 各自独立绑定。
A02: OBS-02 — snapshot 变化要求新鲜 preflight/verification 但不重问未改变边界的用户授权；scope/authority/base/stop boundary 改变必须重新决策。
A03: OBS-03 — inspect/status/doctor/outcome 查询逐字节只读；重复 preflight 幂等并报告写入路径，不暗跑验证。
A04: OBS-04 — status、preflight 和命令拒绝共用版本化 admission、blocker 与下一动作。
A05: OBS-05 — stale/missing preflight 明确指向 run_preflight；刷新前拒绝验证，刷新且快照匹配后可继续，无重复开始确认。
A06: OBS-06 — 必需 scenario/check/evidence 覆盖不完整时在 spawn 前拒绝并指出缺项，执行进程数为 0。
A07: OBS-07 — amend 与 revalidate-amendment 语义/help/下一动作一致，不要求无效重复 revalidation。
A08: OBS-08 — formal receipt rejection 保留执行记录并给出有界具体诊断；verify、Outcome、status 对成功和拒绝一致。
A09: OBS-09 — manifest、MCP tools/list 与 WI 指南暴露真实协作能力；发现后立即通过真实并发多进程、多 linked worktree 及串行回退验收。
A10: OBS-10 — spawn 前持久化 identity-bound attempt，逐节点持久化；真实中断保留 interrupted/signal/cleanup，不投影 passed/reusable。
A11: OBS-11 — 计划期发现必要支持文件；scope 变化早报告，区分同 intent 增补路径和新增意图/权限。
A12: OBS-12 — hosted gate 校验精确 staged candidate 的 lineage、receipt、三语 parity；缺项失败，不合成关闭证据。
A13: OBS-13 — 受影响平台依赖、导入、整数和路径语义有回归，Windows hosted CI 实际执行并纳入 canonical gate。
A14: OBS-14 — 生命周期与 hosted 验证绑定确切 Runtime executable digest；同版本不同 digest 不混用。
A15: OBS-15 — 人读 lint 汇总对相同根因去重，保留每节点结果、raw bytes 和不同根因。
A16: OBS-16 — 未声明可选并行时单 WI serial readiness 允许；显式并行但缺兼容声明仍 fail closed。
A17: OBS-17 — 诊断文字不误报 test weakening，真实绕过仍 fail closed 且能给出匹配文本及来源。
A18: OBS-18 — 三语 close_pending→terminal 投影一致，readyOnBase 与未关闭 archive 列表一致或有明确 Runtime lineage 修复。
A19: OBS-19 — 单主 WI 串行阶段透明；进度只按有证据的验收项报告，不臆测 ETA、不重复请求已覆盖的开始授权。
goal: 形成可由 Runtime 真实准入、执行、恢复、发现和验收的跨 WI 协作闭环；所有 19 项均有本轮回归或真实 CI 证据；合并清理后停在用户全面 review 和 release 决定之前。
intent: 根治 WI-1033 handoff 的 17 项协作治理摩擦及独立复现的 2 项关闭投影与交付沟通摩擦；保持单 WI 串行，实现并验证 Agent 可发现、可实际使用的协作能力。
outOfScope: 发布、打 tag、升级公开版本、修改全局 Agent/MCP 配置、拆分并行子 WI、削弱权限/证据/平台 gate、修改无关 WI 历史或伪造验证/关闭证据

scenarioCoverage.expected: A no-op commit leaves source identity and applicable evidence stable, while a real source-content change invalidates only dependent evidence.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-01 same-tree commit and actual source-content change
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run snapshot/lifecycle regressions for dirty-to-commit, empty commit, and real source change; compare source, Contract, Runtime, preflight, and verification identities.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Snapshot-only change requires fresh preflight and verification without requesting the same bounded human authorization again; a changed authority boundary requires a new decision.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-02 authorization remains distinct from freshness
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add repository lifecycle regressions for snapshot refresh and changed scope/authority/base/stop boundary, including decision-receipt bindings.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repeated inspect/status/doctor/outcome queries do not change repository bytes; repeated unchanged preflight reports no changed paths and does not execute checks.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-03 read-only queries and idempotent explicit preflight
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add byte-for-byte before/after query tests and repeated-preflight changed-path/process-count assertions.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Status, preflight, and a rejected operation expose the same admission version, blockers, and actionable recovery route for the same facts.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add cross-surface repository/CLI tests that compare normalized admission identity and blocker/next-action fields.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Stale/missing preflight rejects verification and points to run_preflight; a fresh matching preflight restores verification without a second start confirmation.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-05 stale or missing preflight recovery
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add checkpointed Work Item tests for stale snapshot and Contract, refresh, rejection before refresh, and admission after refresh.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Removing any required scenario/check/evidence mapping produces a named rejection before any verification process starts.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-06 complete scenario-to-check coverage before spawn
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use an instrumented subprocess counter in composition/verification integration tests and assert zero spawns for each missing mapping.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Amendment output/help explains whether revalidation is already recorded; unchanged Contract does not require an invalid duplicate revalidation command.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add CLI help/output and lifecycle tests for amendment checkpoint creation, repeated command rejection/explanation, and next action.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A rejected formal receipt preserves execution evidence and names bounded failing predicates; verification, Outcome, and status agree on rejected and passing cases.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-08 formal receipt rejection diagnosis and projection
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add end-to-end CLI tests for formal receipt rejection and success, asserting preserved attempt identity, diagnostic limits, and query projections.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An Agent discovers supported capabilities from the local manifest, MCP tool schemas, and ordinary-work-item guide, then uses coordination and serial fallback correctly.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-09 real collaboration capability discovery and usage
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: After interface/docs changes, immediately run old/current manifest parsing, agent doctor, MCP tools/list schema assertions, and real multi-process linked-worktree plus serial CLI acceptance.

scenarioCoverage.expected: An attempt envelope is durable before spawn, each completed node is persisted, and real interruption retains signal and cleanup state without passed/reusable projection.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-10 interrupted verification remains durable and non-passing
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend subprocess acceptance to wait for the pre-spawn checkpoint, send SIGINT, restart/query Runtime, and inspect durable attempt and cleanup records.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Required implementation support paths are visible during planning/preflight; additive same-intent paths are distinguished from new intent/authority before expensive verification.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-11 early discovery of required support-file scope
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add scope planning/preflight regressions for missing supporting paths, additive amendment, and changed intent/authority.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Hosted gates validate exact candidate receipts and all required locale parity rows; missing/unstaged evidence fails closed and no success receipt is synthesized.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-12 exact staged-candidate lineage and locale parity
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add gate-manifest and quality-route regressions for each missing lineage/parity row, then verify the actual hosted PR gate on the candidate SHA.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Affected tests compile and run on supported targets; Windows path comparisons use path semantics and Windows hosted tests are required evidence.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-13 platform-specific dependency and path behavior
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add the platform regression to the canonical manifest/workflow and observe the corresponding hosted Windows job execute and pass.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Equal version strings with different executable digests cannot mix lifecycle or hosted evidence; final lifecycle uses one explicit candidate digest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add tests with same-version/different-digest Runtime contexts; build the final candidate and compare every lifecycle/hosted receipt binding.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Repeated identical lint root causes have one readable human summary while all node-specific statuses/raw bytes and distinct failures remain available.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-15 readable deduplicated lint diagnostics with raw evidence
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add multi-node verification aggregation tests with repeated and distinct diagnostics, including preservation of raw bytes and exit states.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A single serial Work Item without parallel metadata remains ready; an explicit parallel request without compatibility/isolation fails closed.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-16 single-WI serial readiness independent of optional parallel declaration
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Extend parallel_boundary and CLI admission tests with serial positive and parallel negative cases, plus a valid declared-parallel case.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Diagnostic wording alone does not trigger weakening, while an actual skipped/bypassed test still fails the policy gate with source details.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-17 test weakening distinguishes diagnostic prose from bypass behavior
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Keep/add paired diagnostic-text negative and actual xit/skip positive tests and ensure the policy regression is in canonical CI.

scenarioCoverage.expected: close_pending transitions to terminal state without reverting archived docs; all three locale projections agree and readyOnBase reconciles with pending-close lineage.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-18 consistent tri-language close and ready-on-base projection
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add Runtime lifecycle tests using en/zh-CN/ja close projections and assert readiness/pending archive lists across before/after states.

scenarioCoverage.expected: One WI exposes sequential stages and measured acceptance progress; valid unchanged user authority is reused without invented ETA or another start request.
scenarioCoverage.scenario: OBS-19 serial progress reporting without repeated authorization prompts
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Review ordinary-work-item guide and Outcome process against the 7-stage/19-OBS matrix; verify current Runtime receipts and user-facing progress include evidence and blockers.

Serial implementation stages, file/test inventory, commit boundaries, and acceptance matrix.
Original seventeen-item Task 8 handoff and evidence references.
Repository-bound Runtime authority, scope, verification, and release-stop constraints.
